results.reasoning: Driven in the built-in browser against scratch copy judge-focus3 served on :4769 (its /api/blueprint named the copy), on a tall screen of three anchors 1400px apart with three rules moved onto it. Every step holds. Opening the rule with focus tall.far centred it to the pixel with the pin-mode ring on the build side and on the design side after sliding, and also when arriving from the review screen and from a fresh deep link. The fallback holds: a rule whose steps name another screen's panel.legend before tall.mid centred and ringed tall.mid on both sides, and a rule on the review screen ringed its first step anchor. A rule naming no anchor opens at the top with no ring, whether stepped to from the tall.mid rule or deep-linked. Both halves of n-0584 are now fixed: going back to All rules clears the ring on both surfaces, on the tall screen and the review screen alike, and reopening the same rule rings it again. Hovering tall.mid in a step with the frames at the top scrolled it into view and ringed it with either side in front, driven with the real pointer. Focus is outside ruleHash, hash reports ok, and a rule given a focus in the copy kept its checks pass current. Under 10% and not filed: the hover's nearest-edge scroll leaves an element flush with the frame's bottom, clipping the lower edge of its outline, and moving the pointer off a step's anchor also clears the rule's own focus ring, as the code intends.
